This study does not perform normative modeling in the traditional sense of predicting brain measures. Instead, it calculates indices of heterogeneity (Variability Ratio, Coefficient of Variation Ratio) and a Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) to assess variability and 'normativeness'.
